recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality and freshness due to preparation and ingredient issues.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen quality control program, including daily ingredient freshness checks, standardized recipe adherence training for all cooks, and regular taste tests by management.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in food taste, consistency, and freshness, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat business.

recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and customer service leading to negative interactions.
recommendations.action: Develop and implement mandatory customer service training modules focusing on empathy, conflict resolution, and proactive service. Conduct regular staff morale surveys and address underlying issues like understaffing or unfair workload distribution.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, reduced negative staff interactions, and improved staff morale, fostering a more welcoming environment.

recommendations.issue: General negative customer experience due to accumulated minor operational issues and lack of attention to overall ambiance.
recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough operational audit covering all customer touchpoints (e.g., cleanliness, ambiance, order accuracy, speed of service) to identify and rectify systemic inefficiencies and overlooked details. Implement a daily manager checklist for overall restaurant readiness.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more cohesive and pleasant dining environment, reducing overall dissatisfaction and improving the perception of the restaurant.

recommendations.issue: Customers perceive prices as too high for the value received.
recommendations.action: Review current menu pricing against ingredient costs, competitor pricing, and perceived value. Consider offering value-added options (e.g., combo deals, loyalty programs) or slightly adjusting portion sizes/ingredient quality to better align price with customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer perception of value, potentially increasing sales and reducing price-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Excessive wait times for service and food, impacting overall dining experience.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour staffing levels and kitchen workflow. Implement a kitchen display system (KDS) for better order management and communication between front-of-house and back-of-house. Cross-train staff to assist during busy periods.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced wait times, leading to a smoother dining experience and improved customer satisfaction, especially during busy periods.
